is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles arabiensis and Anopheles gambiae (s.s.) (Page 6, Results).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports Vgsc-1014F and Vgsc-1014S (Page 8, Resistance genotyping).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides genotype counts (LL, LF, FF) for An. arabiensis populations by area and year (Page 7).

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Sudan using field-collected Anopheles mosquitoes (Page 1, Abstract; Page 5, Mosquito sampling and rearing).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study monitoring insecticide resistance in Sudan from 2011 to 2014 (Page 1, Abstract).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study identifies four specific districts: El Hoosh, Hag Abdalla, Galabat, and New Halfa (Page 3, Methods).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports data for each year from 2010 to 2014 (Table 1, Page 7).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a primary study reporting original data from a specific monitoring project (SIRAC) in Sudan.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype data is provided in Table 1.

assessment.summary: This study monitored insecticide resistance in Anopheles arabiensis in four districts of Sudan from 2010 to 2014. It assessed phenotypic resistance to deltamethrin, DDT, and bendiocarb, and genotyped Vgsc-1014 mutations. The study found widespread resistance to deltamethrin and DDT, but susceptibility to bendiocarb. It also evaluated the impact of combined LLIN and IRS interventions on resistance evolution.
